articles.title: Personalized savings reminders can help boost retirement savings
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Private retirement savings are an increasingly important topic in public debate. One popular idea is to phrase savings reminders in one of two ways: either you emphasize what someone stands to lose if they don't save, or you emphasize what they stand to gain if they do. To date, research into which of the two reminder messages is more effective in terms of influencing people's efforts to save has produced conflicting results.

articles.title: The hidden ways insects support animal life—from habitat to health—go way beyond being food
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: There are at least 14 million insect species on Earth, and they play highly diverse roles in sustaining the natural world. Insects provide many well-known benefits—what scientists often call "ecosystem services." For example, you can thank a bee or a hoverfly for pollinating wildflowers and agricultural crops, or credit dung beetles for decomposing manure and other waste materials.
